Moreover, if p_7 is truly defined as 'disconnected from heritage', then this should simply be ¬p_6, and using both as independent atomic propositions is misleading. The use of ⊕ implies mutual exclusivity and exhaustiveness, but in modeling, we expect p_7(Jadiel) ≡ ¬p_6(Jadiel), which would make (p_6 ⊕ p_7) always true, thus making the implication reduce to ¬p_8(Jadiel) unconditionally — which is not what the NL says.
